versions.content: If a data element has been received invalidated in case of Inter- ECU communication where receiving software components requesting different val- ues for handleInvalid and the attribute handleInvalid is set to replace for an particular r-port  RTE shall perform the "invalid value substitution" with the init- Value for the r-port . Then the reception will be handled as if a valid value would have been received (activation of runnable entities using the DataReceivedEvent ).
